## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests were added or updated where appropriate.
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `mypy`, and `pytest` pass.
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` were updated for configuration changes.
- [ ] No credentials, raw queries, private URLs, user paths, or generated research data are included.
- [ ] Privacy-sensitive network changes fail closed and include appropriate tests.

## Privacy and quality impact

Explain any effect on egress, logging, storage, retrieval quality, context size, or latency.
